shared_architecture.output: raw degrees C residual added to anchor: last six temperatures, plus their arithmetic mean as Tp anchor

normalization.fitted_on: original 91 fit-field histories only; never recompute
normalization.transform: (first six temperatures-mean)/std; heater/raw full scale; no clipping of temperature, output or normalized inputs; verify checkpoint buffers equal frozen normalization

historical_R0_training.sampler: existing sqrt(source window count) / window count probability; no excitation or cooling sampler
historical_R0_training.optimizer: Adam, reset each stage; default betas [0.9,0.999], eps 1e-8, weight_decay 0, amsgrad false
historical_R0_training.checkpoint: Existing screen.train_variant selection source-macro prediction-only minimum every100 steps; already completed, not repeated

adaptation.factual_loss: screen.factual with stage2: weighted_huber(one_step,y0)+0.35*weighted_huber(recursive,y)+0.08*adjacent_delta_huber+0.1*endpoint_temperature_huber; exact code hashes authoritative
adaptation.sensitivity_loss: lambda_s*(mean(relu(abs(S_pre)-epsilon_pre)^2)+mean(relu(-S_post)^2)); transition unconstrained; epsilon_sign is reporting threshold only
adaptation.checkpoint_rule: exact step75 final state; no early stopping

inference.mode: eval(), inference/no_grad, all parameters requires_grad False
inference.rollout: unchanged paper_models.rollout: at k predict from current history and recorded future[:,k]; append predicted first6 outputs plus that action; discard oldest history row; repeat. No teacher forcing, no true future temperatures, no Tp feedback.
inference.integrity: check model state_dict byte/tensor equality before/after all inference; compare every non-head R0/COISC tensor including buffers

population.identities_and_paths: NOT read, enumerated, resolved, tested for existence, or hashed in this task; obtain ONLY from already locked membership after separate explicit authorization
population.inclusion: all 29 pre-existing frozen sources; no manual selection; no dropping difficult sources or outlier windows; same source/window IDs, ordering, history, recorded control sequences and targets for both models and all seeds
population.primary_population: all29, equal weight per source; preserve external/final role labels
population.cohort_reports: also report external23 and final6 separately as fixed secondary strata; neither stratum may guide changes or become an alternative primary
population.development: 91 fit and18 selection are excluded from frozen inference; no development reevaluation, normalization refit or threshold design
population.preprocessing: use locked native10s windows and original column units: raw power = five2s sample sum =5*mean W. 20-frame history,12-frame factual future, six-heater controls, seven output targets. No new interpolation, denoising, clipping, normalization, segmentation tuning or resampling.
population.missingness: Keep every locked source in inventory. Invalid/nonfinite/missing primary data, mismatched hashes, duplicate source identity or mismatched paired windows prevent a valid overall PASS: emit NOT_EVALUABLE with exact reason and overall_PASS=false. Do not silently take a complete-case subset or replace a source. Empty diagnostic strata are NA, not zero.
population.schema_binding: Frozen storage format/schema and identity-hash manifest intentionally uninspected. Their binding is a prerequisite to a later authorized implementation/run, not evidence of readiness now.

primary_endpoints.estimand: paired change conditional on each fixed trained seed, across the source population. Sources are statistical clusters; overlapping windows and the three model seeds are not independent replicate subjects.

prediction.aggregate: arithmetic mean of source MAEs; equal1/29 weight

sensitivity.units: degrees C per unit UH full-scale fraction, NOT degrees C/W and NOT output-z-scored
sensitivity.perturbation: ONLY current future[:,0,1]: raw +/-25, clipped to[0,500] (5W=5%fullscale). Use actual clipped denominator; all subsequent controls/other heaters equal. Neither initial history is perturbed; native feedback retains the perturbed action thereafter.
sensitivity.transition: tau-10 <= h*10 <= tau+10 unconstrained (lower bounded by0)
sensitivity.PLE: per-source mean abs(S) over windows and eligible pre horizons; equal-source mean
sensitivity.WSR: per-source mean indicator(S < -0.0001) over windows and eligible post horizons; equal-source mean
sensitivity.PSM: median abs(S) over post-lag cells of the equal-source weighted empirical distribution: cell weight1/(N_sources*N_post_cells_of_source). Each source's sorted post abs(S) is retained; not a mean of source medians.
sensitivity.weighted_median: sort cells by abs(S), combine identical values; take first value whose cumulative weight exceeds0.5; if cumulative weight equals0.5, average this value and next positive-weight value. Equal cell weights reproduce numpy.median.
sensitivity.empty_regions: NA plus zero eligible-cell count; T5 has no pre cells; T6 has no post cells; never fill NA with0

decision_proposal.status: pre-unsealing DRAFT for review; no outcome-dependent revision
decision_proposal.principle: Same four endpoint concepts with frozen source-balanced estimands and fixed numerical margins; confirmatory confidence bounds operationalize uncertainty, not new model-selection metrics.

per_seed.Tp_prediction: PASS iff upper endpoint of the two-sided 95% percentile cluster-bootstrap CI of delta_MAE <= +0.005 C
per_seed.PLE: PASS iff source-balanced R0 PLE>0 and point_COISC<=0.9*point_R0 and upper endpoint of the two-sided 95% percentile cluster-bootstrap CI of (PLE_COISC-0.9*PLE_R0)<=0
per_seed.WSR: PASS iff source-balanced R0 WSR>0 and point_COISC<=0.9*point_R0 and upper endpoint of the two-sided 95% percentile cluster-bootstrap CI of (WSR_COISC-0.9*WSR_R0)<=0
per_seed.PSM: PASS iff point_COISC>=max(0.2*point_R0,0.0005) AND lower endpoint of the two-sided 95% percentile cluster-bootstrap CI of (PSM_COISC-0.2*PSM_R0)>=0 AND lower endpoint of the two-sided 95% percentile cluster-bootstrap CI of (PSM_COISC-0.0005)>=0

decision_proposal.overall: PASS only if all four gates pass for each of the three seeds in primary all29 population, and integrity/completeness pass. No averaging away a failed seed. Any estimable gate failing gives FAIL. Missing/nonfinite/insufficient primary data gives NOT_EVALUABLE and overall_PASS=false.
decision_proposal.interpretation: CI failure to establish non-inferiority/improvement is not proof of harm/equality. Exact development point-only gates also reported for comparability, never override the primary CI decision.
decision_proposal.multiplicity: Conjunctive intersection-union claim: every pre-specified gate and seed must pass; no endpoint cherry-picking. No new individual confirmatory claims selected from secondary CIs; secondary intervals are descriptive.

primary_endpoints.aggregation_clarification: The four endpoint concepts are the same. Frozen primary estimands are equal-source/source-balanced; development used legacy pooled aggregation. Numerical gates, margins, lag, lambda, epsilon and checkpoints are unchanged.

statistics.unit: whole source cluster, all its windows/horizons/outputs and both models retained together
statistics.source_level_storage: For each seed/source/horizon/output preserve n, sum_abs_error, sum_squared_error, sum_error; source MAE, MSE/RMSE,bias; PLE sums/counts,WSR wrong-sign counts/denominators, all post abs(S) or losslessly reconstructable raw S for exact PSM.

bootstrap.primary_stratification: Resample23 external source IDs with replacement from23, and6 final IDs with replacement from6. Concatenate29 drawn clusters. Identity order lexicographic within locked roles; preserve role counts. No source-level observation shuffling within a cluster.
bootstrap.pairing: same draw table for R0/COISC, all endpoints, outputs/horizons and all3 seeds; never independently draw R0 and COISC
bootstrap.weights: each drawn cluster has1/29 weight; a source drawn m times contributes m whole-source copies. Do not deduplicate draws; do not weight long sources more.
bootstrap.recompute: In each draw recompute both model estimates, paired absolute difference, relative change and gate contrasts. For PSM reconstruct weighted ECDF with cell weight m/(29*N_post_cells_source); never bootstrap already-pooled window observations.
bootstrap.secondary_cohorts: external-only uses23 within-external draws; final-only uses6 within-final draws, both taken from same primary draw table. Small6-cluster uncertainty limitation reported.
bootstrap.seed_summary: per-seed primary; optional equal-seed mean/median effects descriptive only, with shared source draws; do not treat3*29 as87 independent clusters
bootstrap.nonfinite: Do not discard bootstrap replicates. Any unexpected nonfinite absolute/gate result aborts valid inference. Zero-denominator relative replicates are counted and relative CI reported NA, while finite absolute/gate CIs remain valid.
bootstrap.save: source draw indices, source-order mapping, RNG seed, replicate count and bootstrap draws SHA256; summary rows include n_sources and eligible windows/cells

statistics.relative_change: 100*(COISC/R0-1), ratio of source-balanced aggregate estimates, NOT mean of per-source ratios
statistics.zero_reference: If point R0=0, relative change is NA with reason; if both R0=COISC=0 this is not evidence of improvement and PLE/WSR gate fails. Never add epsilon to a metric denominator.
statistics.report_precision: Store unrounded FP64 values; round only for display. No numerical tolerance widening of gates.

prediction.source_level: MAE=mean abs(error), RMSE=sqrt(mean error^2), bias=mean error; error=prediction-truth
prediction.source_balanced: MAE=mean sourceMAE; RMSE=sqrt(mean sourceMSE); bias=mean sourcebias
prediction.all7: mean of seven output MAEs/RMSEs/biases at each horizon; additionally pooled_RMSE=sqrt(mean output source-balanced MSE). Label aggregation explicitly; macro across horizons weights five horizons equally.
prediction.legacy: separately labeled window_pooled results for comparison with development; never substitute these for source-balanced primary

secondary_endpoints.audit: source x5 horizons x7 outputs x3 seeds; R0_MAE,COISC_MAE,delta_MAE=COISC-R0,RMSE/bias and deltas, count, window absolute-error deltas and quantiles
secondary_endpoints.improvement_counts: delta_MAE<0 improved, >0 worsened, ==0 tied; no post-hoc tolerance. Report counts/denominators by output, horizon, source and seed; window-level counts descriptive only.
secondary_endpoints.sensitivity: PLE/WSR/PSM by every output, source, seed; source-balanced and window-pooled separately; retain S at every10s horizon and percentile10/25/50/75/90 distributions; empty pre/post NA
